title: Speed: ignored return value
prompt:
SPEED DRILL — target under 90 seconds.

What is printed?

```java
String s = "exam";
s.toUpperCase();
System.out.println(s);
```

A. `EXAM`
B. `exam`
C. `Exam`
D. compile error

Call `answer(...)` exactly once with your option letter and a one-sentence reason.

tests.name: B speed
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.answer("B. check"));
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("B"), "answer must start with the correct option letter");
tests.hint: B. Strings are immutable; toUpperCase RETURNS a new string, and ignoring the return changes nothing. A assigns the result implicitly in the reader's head — the classic trap.
